searchText: Yes we can, if you do block in blobs but on a separate channel instead of the same shared channel you get essentially the new proposal You can do kzg and DA just like blobs So it's a simple modification to the current EIP if we wanted to But the new proposal is simple and more focused that's why it's independent If we want to keep it being a subset of BiB, we'd use the same encoding, and would delay custody + sampling, and swapping out the merkle prove with kzg to a later point. E.g. we should then keep the chunk size at 2048 bytes, have blobs be the data object and re-use `bytes_to_blobs` and `compute_cells`. Above you say blob and payload should be kept separate as they have different release times, as well as deadlines - I agree. Similar applies to BALs: I think it's fine to encode them together but we shouldn't have both, BAL entries + txs in one single blob. BAL and txs differ in their consumers, retention window and when they can be safely released, thus, by keeping them as separate groups over the blobs, we still allow BAL blobs to be released earlier without risking leaking txs at the same time.
